content: If dat a is transmitted using an IPv6 UDP socket which is not bound, the TcpIp shall select the interface that has a local address (TcpIpAddrId) which uses the same network prefix as the destination address. If no matching interface is found EthIfCtrl = 0 is sele cted. The TcpIp shall select the source IP address of the IPv6 header according to the source address selection algorithm specifi ed in section 5 of IETF RFC 6724 (Default Address Selection for IPv6).
